Friday, September 18th | 6-9p

Located at Rosie's Lot 7, 10515 Colonial Downs Pkwy., New Kent.

NK Cruisers meet the 1st and 3rd Friday 6-9p or until the last person leaves (November-March). NK Cruisers, a local car enthusiast and cruise-in group bringing the car community together between Richmond and Williamsburg. The focus is New Kent, Charles City, and Lanexa but we welcome all folks from all areas. All years, makes, models, years, cars, truck, motorcycles, golf carts, boats, tractors, and trailered vehicles always welcome. Inclement weather cancels. past.body:
(Weekly) Doumar's cruise-in Hosted by The Mustang and Ford Association of Virginia

Wednesday, September 16th | 6-8p

Located at Doumar's Cones & Barbecue, 1919 Monticello Ave., Norfolk.

Please join us for some cars at a weekly cruise-in every Wednesday night until it gets cold, all are invited! Bring your rides out and have some fun. They are open during these hours, so enjoy all the great eats and drinks they provide, including their amazing ice cream and handmade cones!

Be kind, clean up after yourselves, no excessive revving, and no burnouts and do not speed off when leaving their parking lot.

past.title: Boost and Brunch NN | Sept 13th
past.body:
(2nd Sun) Boost and Brunch NN

SUNDAY, September 30th | 8:30-11a

Located at 369 Chatham Dr, Newport News, VA 23602-4382, United States

Rev up your engines and fuel your passion for cars at our event! Whether you're a gearhead or just love seeing stunning rides, this is the place to be. Join us for a morning filled with:

Classic cars, exotic rides, and custom builds
Freshly brewed coffee to kickstart your day*
Meet fellow car enthusiasts and share stories
Music, vibes, vendors, and more!

When: Every 2nd Sunday of each month (April - November)
Time: 830am - 11am
Where: 369 Chatham dr in Newport News

Bring your car, bring your friends, and let's make it a morning to remember. All cars, all makes, and all enthusiasts welcome!

Learn more

past.title: Classic Cruisers Saturday Night Cruz In | Sept 12th
past.body:
(Weekly) Classic Cruisers Saturday Night Cruz In Presented by Classic Cruisers Car Club

Saturday, September 12th | 4:30-8p

Located at Coastal Community Church, 101 Village Ave., Yorktown.

Mark your calendar to join us for our 1st Cruise-In. Cruz-Ins will be every Saturday from Apr 25 to Oct 24.

All years and types of vehicles are welcome – If you believe it’s cool, bring it in. We are asking for a $2.00 donation per vehicle. Please consider donating more – All proceeds go to charity. Vehicles are to be parked as directed by club personnel when necessary. No bicycles, skateboards, scooters, roller blades, or anything used in a manner that could injure people or damage vehicles are allowed in the participant parking area. Please do not touch vehicles without owners’ permission. Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult. No horseplay is allowed with vehicles at any time. (Such as burn-outs, engine revving, car hopping, loud radios or other disruptive actions). Alcoholic beverages, illegal drugs, and firearms are prohibited. There are to be NO SALES within the participant parking area EXCEPT for pre-approved items where the sale benefits charity. We are guests here. So PLEASE either take your trash with you or use the receptacles provided. 

Listing is provided by our Partnership with Don Pablo presents Car Crazy in Tidewater!

past.title: Cars and Coffee Chesapeake | Sept 12th
past.body:
[2nd sat] Cars and Coffee Chesapeake

Saturday, September 12th | 8a-11a

Located at Everbowl - 1244 Greenbrier Pkwy #570, Chesapeake, VA 23320

Team Ultraspeed and Everbowl are teaming up to bring you the best Cars and Coffee meets in the area! Come hangout and help us close out the 2025 Car Season. We are collecting non-perishable goods this month for the Foodbank of Southwestern VA. Give Thanks, Give Food. Help us drive out hunger! We are also still collecting new kids pajamas to support Pajama Jams. Pajama Jams collects these items throughout the year in preparation for their important Annual Holiday Pajama Drive for Hampton Roads. Please drop off your donations at the Red Ultraspeed tent, you can write it off on your taxes! We are now a 501(C)3! You won't want to miss this, so mark your calendars and we'll see you there! 

More info

past.title: 15th Annual AOH Car Show | Sept. 12th
past.body:
15th Annual AOH Car Show

Saturday, September 12th | 8a-3p

Located at 4552 Princess Anne Road, Virginia Beach, VA

Fund-raiser event for the Ancient Order of Hibernians, St Patrick Div1. Located at Catholic High School. Participant and audience voting for trophy-awards in all classes, participant dash-plaques for all show cars. Special Youth Judging Class #12 for all makes/models to be judged by our young people. All makes/models. DJ-Music, & food for sale on site. All proceeds are a charitable donation to the St Patrick Division AOH, a registered 501c Charity. No alcohol, no glass containers or any drugs on field, show cars should have a fire extinguisher.

Registration fee: $20.00 in advance, $25.00 after 1 SEP/Day of the show.

Event Contact: Mark Monaghan, jaxops1@verizon.net

Register Here

past.title: 18th Annual Boulevard of Wheels Custom Car Show | Sept 5th
past.body:
18th Annual Boulevard of Wheels Custom Car Show

Saturday, September 5th | 9a-3p

Located at Hackers Bar & Grille - 1532 Laskin Rd. Virginia Beach, VA. 23451 (Hilltop East)

For 18 consecutive years, on Labor Day weekend, ￼the Boulevard of Wheels presented by Street Dreams Corvette Club has consistently built upon the triumph of its previous shows. Each year it’s our goal to present an event that surpasses its predecessor in excellence. Just as previous shows, this one will be consistent with our standards as far as history and tradition, but at our NEW LOCATION.

The new venue will be Hackers Bar & Grille a luxury golf-themed restaurant and sports bar located at 1532 Laskin Rd. Virginia Beach, VA. 23451 (Hilltop East).

This location provides a bigger, better, and bolder experience in every aspect, offering participants a unique never been done before car show experience in a convenient location.
This location will offer an accommodating show field, prominent aesthetics and a serene atmosphere.
Featuring a modern sports lounge with a focus on both leisure and entertainment.
Key Features:
•Hi-Def Golf Simulators
•Cigar Lounge
•Food & Drink
•Sports Viewing (65 TVs throughout)
•Games
This prime location is so nice that I have to say it twice-This prime location is so nice and it’s just minutes away from everything (The Oceanfront, VB Town Center, Lynnhaven Mall, Ocean Breeze Water Park, VB Aquarium) and much more.
We invite you to attend the show and
make it a memorable weekend. Our hosting hotel will be, the Doubletree 1900 Pavilion Dr. Virginia Beach, VA 23451. A special SDCC discounted rate will be offered. So come join us on (Labor Day Weekend) Saturday September 5, 2026 from 9am-3pm. Pre-registration fee $25 Day of show $30. There will be a Meet & Greet on Friday evening from 6pm-10pm at Hackers as well. Hope to see you there.

More info

Monthly car meet on the 1st  Saturday of every month. All cars, motorcycles, bicycles, etc. welcome! Free coffee and doughnuts!

We're temporarily hosting our first Saturday events at Greenbrier Mall in Chesapeake. We will be in the lot behind the old Sears, at the back of the mall. As you enter, turn left and drive around the perimeter of the parking lot to the back where we'll be set up with the tent.

Please be respectful of the temporary location and help us keep the event going. ABSOLUTELY NO: Revving, burnouts, loud music. Be on your best behavior and respect the location.
